CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_r7.office_work_roots()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform eflow_r3.actor();return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.id) from public.tasks t where eflow_r7.read_root(t.id) and exists(select 1 from public.subtasks n where n.task_id=t.id and eflow_m7.node_visible(t.id,n.id,auth.uid()) and eflow_r7.member(t.linked_project_id,t.org_id,auth.uid()) and eflow_r7.chain(t.id,n.parent_subtask_id) and (auth.uid()=any(n.assigned_to_ids) or n.lead_id=auth.uid()))),'[]');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_r7.m7_baseline_snapshot(p_root uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r jsonb:=eflow_r7.root(p_root);v_nodes jsonb;v_people jsonb;begin
 if not eflow_r7.read_root(p_root) then raise exception 'Nested work access denied' using errcode='42501';end if;
 with recursive tree as (
  select n.*,1 depth,array[n.sibling_order] path from eflow_r7.nodes n where n.task_id=p_root and n.parent_subtask_id is null
  union all select n.*,t.depth+1,t.path||n.sibling_order from eflow_r7.nodes n join tree t on n.parent_subtask_id=t.id where n.task_id=p_root and t.depth<8
 ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)||jsonb_build_object('capabilities',eflow_r7.operation_capabilities(p_root,t.id),'can_manage',eflow_publication.manage_plan(p_root,t.id),'can_appoint',eflow_publication.manage_plan(p_root,t.id,true),'can_order',eflow_publication.manage_plan(p_root,t.parent_subtask_id),'can_work',eflow_r7.node_work(t.id,auth.uid()),'can_review',t.status='for_review' and eflow_r7.pending_reviewer(t.id)=auth.uid(),'current_reviewer',eflow_r7.pending_reviewer(t.id)) order by path,id),'[]'::jsonb) into v_nodes from tree t;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.full_name,'office',p.org_id,'eligible',eflow_r7.member((r->>'project')::uuid,(r->>'office')::uuid,p.id)) order by p.full_name,p.id),'[]'::jsonb) into v_people from public.profiles p where eflow_r7.member((r->>'project')::uuid,(r->>'office')::uuid,p.id) or p.id=(r->>'lead')::uuid or coalesce(r->'people','[]') ? p.id::text or exists(select 1 from eflow_r7.nodes n where n.task_id=p_root and (n.lead_id=p.id or p.id=any(n.assigned_to_ids)));
 return jsonb_build_object('root',r||jsonb_build_object('capabilities',eflow_r7.operation_capabilities(p_root)),'revision',coalesce((select revision from eflow_r7.tree_state where root_id=p_root),1),'can_manage',eflow_publication.manage_plan(p_root,null),'can_transfer',eflow_r7.head(p_root),'nodes',v_nodes,'people',v_people,
 'leaf_total',(select count(*) from eflow_r7.nodes n where n.task_id=p_root and not exists(select 1 from eflow_r7.nodes c where c.parent_subtask_id=n.id)),
 'leaf_completed',(select count(*) from eflow_r7.nodes n where n.task_id=p_root and n.status='completed' and not exists(select 1 from eflow_r7.nodes c where c.parent_subtask_id=n.id)));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.with_visible_counts(p_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with nodes as materialized (
  select node.value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_snapshot->'nodes','[]'::jsonb)) as node(value)
 ), parent_ids as materialized (
  select distinct n.value->>'parent_subtask_id' AS id
  from nodes n where nullif(n.value->>'parent_subtask_id','') is not null
 ), leaves as (
  select n.value
  from nodes n left join parent_ids p on p.id=n.value->>'id'
  where p.id is null
 )
 select p_snapshot || jsonb_build_object(
  'leaf_total',count(*),
  'leaf_completed',count(*) filter (where leaves.value->>'status'='completed')
 ) from leaves;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.with_schedule(p_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_set(jsonb_set(p_snapshot,'{root,scheduling}',jsonb_build_object(
  'version',1,'today',eflow_m7.work_day((p_snapshot->'root'->>'id')::uuid))),
  '{nodes}',coalesce((
   select jsonb_agg(n.value || jsonb_build_object('start_date',s.start_date,'started_at',s.started_at,
    'effective_status',case when s.started_at is not null and n.value->>'status'='todo'
      then 'in_progress' else n.value->>'status' end) order by n.ordinality)
   from jsonb_array_elements(p_snapshot->'nodes') with ordinality n(value,ordinality)
   left join lateral (
    select start_date,started_at from public.subtasks where id=(n.value->>'id')::uuid and p_snapshot->'root'->>'kind'='office'
    union all
    select start_date,started_at from public.personal_subtasks where id=(n.value->>'id')::uuid and p_snapshot->'root'->>'kind'='personal'
   ) s on true
   where case when p_snapshot->'root'->>'kind'='office' then eflow_m7.node_visible(
     (p_snapshot->'root'->>'id')::uuid,(n.value->>'id')::uuid,auth.uid())
   else eflow_m7.personal_node_visible((p_snapshot->'root'->>'id')::uuid,(n.value->>'id')::uuid) end
  ),'[]'::jsonb));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.node_visible(p_root uuid, p_node uuid, p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.can_see_task(p_root,p_actor) and exists(
  select 1 from public.subtasks s where s.task_id=p_root and s.id=p_node
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.can_view_linked_work(p_task uuid, p_node uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select (p_task is null or public.can_see_task(p_task,auth.uid()))
  and (p_node is null or eflow_m7.node_visible(p_task,p_node,auth.uid()));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.can_view_work_event(p_root uuid, p_node uuid, p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select eflow_r7.read_root(p_root) and (
  (eflow_r7.root(p_root)->>'lead')::uuid=auth.uid()
  or (p_node is null or eflow_m7.node_visible(p_root,p_node,auth.uid()) or eflow_m7.personal_node_visible(p_root,p_node))
  and not exists(
   select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_before->'nodes','[]') || coalesce(p_after->'nodes','[]')) n
   where not (eflow_m7.node_visible(p_root,(n->>'id')::uuid,auth.uid()) or eflow_m7.personal_node_visible(p_root,(n->>'id')::uuid))
  )
 );
$function$
